issues.summary: Plan's initial 512 KiB UI-resource ceiling is smaller than the real official React example artifacts (~531 KiB single-file HTML)
issues.correction: Resource ceiling raised to documented hard-bounded 1 MiB; resources/read envelope ceiling 1.25 MiB; tool-result ceiling kept at 512 KiB; recorded as plan deviation

issues.summary: Initialize-negotiation expectation wrong; import.meta bundle fallback defeated boot-failure simulation; semaphore cache ignored changed capacity
issues.correction: Test corrected + extended; GALLERY_RESOURCE_BUNDLE_PATH override seam; semaphore cache keyed by slug+capacity (REG-001)

issues.summary: SBOM generator undercounted pnpm's non-hoisted closure, then failed under a pnpm-9 standalone npm_execpath that cannot read the pnpm-10 store
issues.correction: Rewrote as in-process module-graph walk (no subprocess); resolves exports-hidden manifests; fails on unresolved packages; 7 components

regressions.summary: appSemaphore cached by slug only, so a caller with a different capacity silently reused a stale ceiling
regressions.userImpactIfShipped: None for the static production registry; a capacity change without instance restart discipline could have enforced a stale ceiling
regressions.correction: Cache key includes capacity; concurrency test observes successes and 429 shedding
